interface.shortDescription: Checked cohort construction over validated run observations; diagnosis, rendering and verification are held runbook steps.
interface.longDescription: Synkrisis owns bounded comparison across validated Promise Machine run observations, and version 0.2.0 lands its first operation. An operator names a manifest of validated, redacted, receipt-bound observation records and a comparison policy classifying every run-context dimension; cohort construction checks the producer contract, recomputes digests and bound prefixes, holds the declared caps, and classifies every declared run as included, excluded with the exact policy field responsible, or unknown, written atomically with no partial output behind a refusal. The held runbook steps still refuse: diagnosis will apply a digest-bound deterministic rule catalogue, rendering a fixed-template report, and verification a whole-path byte recomputation. A future finding remains a bounded inferred relation with evidence, counterevidence, unknowns, the nearest claim it refuses and one suggested handoff. A person decides what happens. Synkrisis never calls a model, judges model quality, states a cause, files an issue, edits a repository or dispatches another skill.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $synkrisis to build one checked cohort from declared run observations under my comparison policy.
